GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.5 (26 Jul 46) GS
(SCAPIN-1086)
APO 500
26 July 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Temporary Retention of Public Official under SCAPIN 550 - Haruo Matsui.
1. Reference is made to C.L.O. No. 3502 (PP), dated 18 July 1946, subject: "Retention of Haruo MATSUI".
2. The request contained in reference C.L.O. for the temporary retention in office of Haruo MATSUI for a period of two weeks commencing 18 July 1946, is approved. At the expiration of the stated period he will be removed from public office and excluded from government service as an undesirable person under the terms of SCAPIN 550.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
